item: H3 - real DOM control on a real public site, Chrome and Edge
method: OCADE filled a real input and submitted a real form through its own form.fill / form.submit protocol. Every outcome was then read back independently from the page — the value sitting in the DOM, and the URL and title after submission — rather than trusting the extension's reply.
permissionNote: chrome.permissions.request requires a user activation, so it was called with Runtime.evaluate userGesture. That supplies the same activation a real click does; it does not bypass the consent check, which still had to return true.

fillReply.error: A protected or malformed form field was refused.
